22835-the-london-visitor.title: The London Visitor
22835-the-london-visitor.creator: Mary Russell Mitford
22835-the-london-visitor.description: A book by Mary Russell Mitford. Last Thursday morning, being the 23rd day of this present month of June, I received a note from my kind friend and neighbour, Mrs. Dunbar, requesting very earnestly that my father and myself would dine that evening at the Hall, apologising for the short notice, as arising out of the unexpected arrival of a guest from London, and the equally unexpected absence of the General, which threw her (she was pleased to say) upon our kindness to assist in entertaining her visitor.

arxiv-2005-09538.title: Conformational Landscape of Oxygen-Containing Naphthalene Derivatives
arxiv-2005-09538.creator: Manuel Goubet, Marie-Aline Martin-Drumel, Florent Réal, Valérie Vallet, Olivier Pirali
arxiv-2005-09538.description: Abstract Polycyclic aromatic compounds (PACs) constitute an important class of molecules found in various environments and are considered important pollutants of the Earth’s atmosphere. In particular, functionalization of PACs modify the ring aromaticity, which greatly influences the chemical reactivity of these species. In this work we studied several oxygen-containing PACs, relevant to atmospheric chemistry.

arxiv-2405-03338.title: Quantum Algorithms for Inverse Participation Ratio Estimation in multi-qubit and multi-qudit systems
arxiv-2405-03338.creator: Yingjian Liu, Piotr Sierant, Paolo Stornati, Maciej Lewenstein, Marcin Płodzień
arxiv-2405-03338.description: Abstract Inverse Participation Ratios (IPRs) and the related Participation Entropies quantify the spread of a quantum state over a selected basis of the Hilbert space, offering insights into the equilibrium and non-equilibrium properties of the system. In this work, we propose three quantum algorithms to estimate IPRs on multi-qubit and multi-qudit quantum devices.

arxiv-2412-03330.title: Testing CPS with Design Assumptions-Based Metamorphic Relations and Genetic Programming
arxiv-2412-03330.creator: Claudio Mandrioli, Seung Yeob Shin, Domenico Bianculli, Lionel Briand
arxiv-2412-03330.description: Abstract Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) software is used to enforce desired behaviours on physical systems. To test the interaction between the CPS software and the system’s physics, engineers provide traces of desired physical states and observe traces of the actual physical states. CPS requirements describe how closely the actual physical traces should track the desired traces.

pmc-10672485.title: Atherosclerosis in Patients with Congenital Hemophilia: A Focus on Peripheral Artery Disease
pmc-10672485.creator: Minerva Codruta Badescu, Oana Viola Badulescu, Alexandru Dan Costache, Ovidiu Mitu, Vasile Valeriu Lupu, Bianca-Ana Dmour, Ancuta Lupu, Liliana Georgeta Foia, Irina-Iuliana Costache, Ciprian Rezus, Eleni Gavriilaki
pmc-10672485.description: Advances in the treatment of hemophilia have increased the life expectancy of this population and we are currently facing diseases associated with aging, including cardiovascular ones. Coronary atherosclerosis, with acute myocardial infarction as the most severe form of manifestation, has been recognized as part of the comorbidities of hemophiliacs. However, little is known about peripheral artery disease.

pmc-11301980.title: Sleep quality and associated factors among people who inject drugs in Iran: a nationwide survey using respondent-driven sampling
pmc-11301980.creator: Rahmatollah Moradzadeh, Khosro Sadeghniiat-Haghighi, Arezu Najafi, Hamid Sharifi, Narges Abdolmohamadi, Fatemeh Hadavandsiri, Samaneh Akbarpour
pmc-11301980.description: BackgroundPoor sleep quality is a significant issue among people who inject drugs (PWID). This study aimed to evaluate sleep quality and associated factors among PWID in Iran.MethodsUsing respondent-driven sampling, 2,652 PWID (2,563 male) were recruited in 11 major cities in Iran between 2019 and 2020.

pmc-11336771.title: TMEM176B Prevents and alleviates bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis via inhibiting transforming growth factor β-Smad signaling
pmc-11336771.creator: Ziwei Wang, Hehua Zhao
pmc-11336771.description: Pulmonary fibrosis is a severe and progressive lung disease characterized by the abnormal accumulation of extracellular matrix, leading to scarring and loss of normal lung function. Recent bioinformatics analysis through the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database identified a significant downregulation of Transmembrane Protein 176B (TMEM176B), previously unexplored in the context of fibrotic lung tissues.

pmc-11419997.title: First-in-human cases and preclinical experience of a novel ICE catheter
pmc-11419997.creator: Guangan Liu, Jingjing Wu, Fang Fang, Weipeng Zhao, Minmin Sun, Jihong Zhang, Simeng Liu, Mimi Wang, Feng Liu
pmc-11419997.description: IntroductionThe primary objective of our study was to evaluate the first use of a novel intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) catheter in human subjects. This study aimed to assess its practicality, image clarity, and guidance role during electrophysiology procedures.MethodsTwo patients underwent procedures using the novel ICE catheter.

pmc-11749052.title: Extrafollicular Adenomatoid Odontogenic Tumors: A Series of Five Rare Cases with an Insight into Its Clinicopathological Aspects
pmc-11749052.creator: Debarati Ray, Snehanjan Sarangi, Tathagata Bhattacharjee, Jay Gopal Ray
pmc-11749052.description: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumors (AOT), first described by Steensland in 1905, are benign, slowly enlarging, nonaggressive, odontogenic epithelial neoplasms comprising 3%–7% of all odontogenic tumors. They tend to originate from the dental lamina remnants or the reduced enamel epithelium. Mutation at codon 12 of KRAS oncogene (Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog) plays a pivotal role in the pathogenesis.

pmc-12575649.title: Three stages of plateau evolution manifested in present-day Tibetan Plateau

pmc-12575649.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Notwithstanding the evolution of the Tibetan Plateau being a fundamental topic in continental dynamics, general mechanisms of Plateau uplift remain elusive and past Plateau evolution models lack clarity of the actual geodynamical process.

pmc-12749482.creator: Mohan Kumar Anand Raj, P. Manoj Kumar, Praveensabari Palanisamy, Sanjay Dharmaraju, Sureshkumar Periyasamy, Murugesan Palaniappan, Dawit Tafesse Gebreyohannes

pmc-13396308.title: Candidiasis in Diabetes: Five-Year Retrospective on Glycaemic Control
pmc-13396308.creator: Aiah M. Khateb, Walaa M mohammedsaeed, Hajer Bin Shuraym, Zain J Alghamdi
pmc-13396308.description: BackgroundFungal infections are a significant global health burden, affecting over a billion individuals annually. Diabetes mellitus (DM) is a major risk factor, with over 7 million diabetic patients in Saudi Arabia. This study aimed to identify common fungal pathogens and associated risk factors in DM patients at King Fahad Hospital in Medina.

pmc-13408607.title: Comparative Evaluation of Efficiency and Efficacy of Caries Excavation Burs in Pediatric Patients: A Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-13408607.creator: Riya A Pursnani, Ashish Saxena, Shikhar P Chauhan
pmc-13408607.description: Aims and backgroundTo investigate and compare the cutting efficiency (time taken) and efficacy based on visual criteria, tactile criteria, and assessment by caries detecting dye of smart bur and diamond point in primary molars of children between 3 and 9 years. Dental caries is a progressive breakdown of tooth structure, often due to poor dietary habits in children.

pmc-13502260.title: Comparison of U.S. FDA premarket approval studies between two non-diffractive extended depth of focus lenses (AcrySof IQ Vivity versus TECNIS PureSee)
pmc-13502260.creator: Zahra Adamji, Hanna Pawlowski, Sanjana Molleti, Zahraa O Alomar, Mina M Sitto, Phillip C Hoopes, Majid Moshirfar
pmc-13502260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Several recent clinical studies have directly compared TECNIS PureSee with lenses from the Vivity platform; however, direct comparative clinical data specifically involving AcrySof IQ Vivity remain limited. Therefore, we aimed to indirectly compare the visual and patient-reported outcomes of two non-diffractive extended depth of focus (EDOF) intraocular lenses (IOLs), AcrySof IQ Vivity and TECNIS PureSee, using data from their respective FDA premarket approval (PMA) studies.Methods:In this indirect cross-trial comparison, aggregate 6-month outcomes were compared from the FDA Summary of Safety and Effectiveness

pmc-13640115.title: Estimating stage-specific lung cancer costs for economic evaluation of LDCT screening in Ireland: a patient-level microsimulation
pmc-13640115.creator: Tatiana Bezdenezhnykh, James F. O’Mahony, Jarushka Naidoo, Koen de Nijs, Deirdre Murray, Daniel Ryan, Alan Smith, Seamus Cotter, Kathleen Bennett, Benjamin M. Jacob, Patrick Redmond
pmc-13640115.description: BackgroundLung cancer imposes a significant clinical and economic burden in Ireland, with low five-year survival rates and no national low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) screening. Stage-specific cost estimates are essential for economic evaluation but are lacking, particularly as novel, high-cost therapies shift treatment patterns. This study estimates stage-stratified lung cancer costs over five years from the Irish public payer perspective.

pmc-13661680.title: Model-based meta-analysis of individual patient data for the characterization of intravenous 5-fluorouracil population pharmacokinetics

Using an individual patient data model-based meta-analysis (IPD-MBMA) approach, this study aims to build a generalized model by combining IPD from multiple studies, investigating the role of lean body mass (LBM) in 5-FU PK, and exploring a model informed precision dosing (MIPD)-based approach for refining its therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM).MethodsRaw PK data from three 5-FU PK studies (726 patients, 2,332 plasma concentrations) were harmonized and grouped into one

pmc-13677034.title: Identification and functional analysis of sRNAs in Pseudomonas aeruginosa quorum sensing and virulence regulation
pmc-13677034.creator: Tianmin Li, Beifang Lu, Fang Chen, Letong Xu, Yizhou Zhang, Fangzhou Xie, Yue Sun, Chunyan Yao, Jiadai Huang, Tianlong He, Youyue Li, Yiqing Ding, Haiyan Hu, Shaojun Tang, Xin Deng
pmc-13677034.description: Small RNAs (sRNAs) act as critical regulators of post-transcriptional activity and diverse cellular processes in bacteria. However, the entire repertoire of sRNAs and their functions has not yet been extensively studied. This study employs a novel combined computational-experimental prediction approach to identify and characterize small RNAs (sRNAs) in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2251.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2251 — Reimbursement of Production and Marketing Administration appropriations for expenses of maintaining registers of indebtedness and making set-offs
uslaw-usc-t7-s2251.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2251.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 55 (Department Of Agriculture). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Beginning with the fiscal year 1942, each appropriation to enable the Secretary of Agriculture to carry into effect any program administered through the Production and Marketing Administration may, in the discretion of the Secretary, be reimbursed out of the then current appropriation for the agency affected.
